section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a single study (Study 1) that examined the psychometric properties of the German version of the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) in an Austrian community sample of 156 women and 144 men. The study found good internal reliability and construct validity for the BAS, with gender-specific analyses showing that women with lower BMIs reported greater body appreciation while no such association was found for men.
